title: LetShare — LAN vs Internet Comparison
description: The one intentional exception to LetShare's per-app dashboard isolation. Uses a Mixed datasource so each panel queries both influxdb-lan and influxdb-internet directly — the underlying buckets are never merged, only compared visually here.

targets.query:
avg  = from(bucket: "lan_transfers")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "transfer_summary" and r._field == "avgSpeedBps")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.outcome == "done")
  |> mean() |> set(key: "metric", value: "avg")

med  = from(bucket: "lan_transfers")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "transfer_summary" and r._field == "avgSpeedBps")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.outcome == "done")
  |> median() |> set(key: "metric", value: "median")

p95  = from(bucket: "lan_transfers")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "transfer_summary" and r._field == "avgSpeedBps")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.outcome == "done")
  |> quantile(q: 0.95) |> set(key: "metric", value: "p95")

union(tables: [avg, med, p95]) |> set(key: "app", value: "LAN")

avg  = from(bucket: "internet_transfers")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "transfer_summary" and r._field == "avgSpeedBps")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.outcome == "done")
  |> mean() |> set(key: "metric", value: "avg")

med  = from(bucket: "internet_transfers")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "transfer_summary" and r._field == "avgSpeedBps")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.outcome == "done")
  |> median() |> set(key: "metric", value: "median")

p95  = from(bucket: "internet_transfers")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "transfer_summary" and r._field == "avgSpeedBps")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.outcome == "done")
  |> quantile(q: 0.95) |> set(key: "metric", value: "p95")

union(tables: [avg, med, p95]) |> set(key: "app", value: "Internet")

panels.title: Avg Connection Setup Time (NAT traversal cost)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "lan_transfers")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "transfer_summary" and r._field == "connectionMs")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.outcome == "done")
  |> mean()
  |> set(key: "app", value: "LAN")

from(bucket: "internet_transfers")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "transfer_summary" and r._field == "connectionMs")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.outcome == "done")
  |> mean()
  |> set(key: "app", value: "Internet")

success = from(bucket: "lan_transfers")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "transfer_summary" and r._field == "totalBytes")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.outcome == "done")
  |> count() |> set(key: "status", value: "successful")

failed  = from(bucket: "lan_transfers")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "transfer_summary" and r._field == "totalBytes")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.outcome != "done")
  |> count() |> set(key: "status", value: "failed")

union(tables: [success, failed]) |> set(key: "app", value: "LAN")

success = from(bucket: "internet_transfers")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "transfer_summary" and r._field == "totalBytes")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.outcome == "done")
  |> count() |> set(key: "status", value: "successful")

failed  = from(bucket: "internet_transfers")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "transfer_summary" and r._field == "totalBytes")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.outcome != "done")
  |> count() |> set(key: "status", value: "failed")

union(tables: [success, failed]) |> set(key: "app", value: "Internet")

from(bucket: "lan_transfers")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "transfer_summary" and r._field == "avgSpeedBps")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.outcome == "done")
  |> set(key: "app", value: "LAN")

from(bucket: "internet_transfers")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "transfer_summary" and r._field == "avgSpeedBps")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.outcome == "done")
  |> set(key: "app", value: "Internet")
